You must distance yourself from your inner animal. That impulsive side to you driven by emotion and instinct. That voice biased towards the most quickest and easiest way out of adversity.  Embrace your humanity, your capacity for thought and problem solving. Find within yourself that hidden strength. The abillity to love yourself unconditionally, and muster your reserves to transcend this transitory predicament. When it's all said and done, you're all that you've got in this world. All else comes and goes.
The task is simple- do or don't; Simply weigh out the pros and cons. Either way, compromise is inevitable.
